PR #90 opened: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/90

**Summary of the scan:**

Ran a fresh, live verification pass across Server + Supabase + Vercel + GitHub (not from memory) and found/fixed real drift in `MASTER_INDEX.yaml`:

1. **`audit198_framework`** — path pointed at a nonexistent `ai-os/scripts/audit198/`; `STANDING_DIRECTIVE.yaml` had already been fixed to the real `ai-os/audit198/` on 2026-07-22, but `MASTER_INDEX.yaml` never got the matching correction. Fixed.
2. **`engine_registry`** — the biggest finding: it has always cited `ai-os/engines/ENGINES.yaml` as the "247 VCEL engines" registry, but that file is actually an unrelated Z.ai/Claude-Code agent-authorization grant (`git log --follow` shows one unrelated commit, ever). The real VCEL engine registry lives at `compliance-tracker/src/lib/engines/*.ts`. Confirmed this is *not* a collision with `engines_gateways_architecture` (that non-collision holds) — just a mis-citation nobody had caught. Fixed here; flagged for compliance-tracker's own identical copy (out of this repo's boundary).
3. **PR #79 and #82** were recorded as "open" but fresh `gh api` calls showed both had already merged mid-session. **PR #80** moved from a git conflict to mergeable-clean. All updated with evidence.
4. **Supabase migration count** — fresh read-only query returned 261, exactly matching PR #563/#569's claim, no drift.
5. **`database_catalog`** — PR #567 regenerated it to 449 tables/124 enums, but both the live-runtime copy and compliance-tracker's own on-server clone (stale, 7 commits behind `origin/main`) still show the old 444/124. Documented, not fixed (outside this repo's git history).
6. Added the required dated summary section confirming engine coverage (1 full/19 partial/0 none) and that all four systems remain cross-referenced from this one file.

`git diff --stat` confirms only `MASTER_INDEX.yaml` changed — no new files. PR is open, not merged, per constraints.
